game_concept: A card battler set in The Kingdom – Moat Bridge, the drawbridge over the moat: the town guard must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Score Keeper: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while rogue crows close in.
theme: The Kingdom – Moat Bridge: the drawbridge over the moat
core_gameplay_loop: In Moat Bridge, repeat each round: Update score, lives and ammo variables after every event while rogue crows close in. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the score value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about score to power up the town guard and open the granary door.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Score Keeper
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Score Keeper' (Week 1 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Moat Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Moat Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
